# Widget

## Troubleshooting

### SSH authentication keeps failing

Stale keys cause this. Move the old key directory out of the way, then reconnect:

    mv ~/.ssh ~/.ssh.bak

The next connection attempt creates fresh keys.

final: Moved the old ssh directory to fix authentication issues
